relations.relationship: Defends the preservation of factual truth against official historical rewriting and its reduction to opinion.
relations.evidence_note: Selected interview questions on the Eichmann controversy and factual truth. Her account of the controversy remains attributed; illustrative claims about other historians or states are not independently certified. This concerns factual accountability, not immunity of interpretations from debate.
